properties.description: One source sets off a Suricata scan signature and logs in to Cowrie within the same hour: reconnaissance and initial access from the same address, joined across the two sensors by src_ip. Most scanners never log in, and most bots that log in never trip a scan signature, so the pair is rarer and more deliberate than either half. Buckets are fixed hours, so a pair that straddles a boundary is missed.
